cohort: Neonatal lambs (n=42) born to ewes with experimentally induced maternal asthma (n=26) or control ewes (n=16).
finding: Lambs exposed to maternal asthma in utero had narrower airway diameters and thinner reticular basement membranes, but similar airway-associated smooth muscle area, compared with unexposed control lambs.
birth_weight: Lamb body weights were similar between groups, specific values not provided.
